description:
A Fresh Way to Do Statistics

JASP is a cross-platform software that allows you to conduct statistical analyses in seconds, and without having to learn programming or risking a programming mistake. It aims to be a complete statistical package for both Bayesian and Frequentist statistical methods, that is easy to use and familiar to users of SPSS.
Important Fixes
- in Repeated Measures Anova, descriptive plot legend says 'descriptivePlotSeparateLines' (issue https://github.com/jasp-stats/jasp-issues/issues/4611, PR https://github.com/jasp-stats/jaspBase/pull/224
- Plot crash in Descriptives, when resizing plots and changing afterwards the split variable (https://github.com/jasp-stats/jasp-desktop/commit/aedcc42fccc28a88cb72251eb338af39b3142b57, https://github.com/jasp-stats/jasp-desktop/commit/72e33c3db9a923936d3e9b9306a9e3ff531c27e9, https://github.com/jasp-stats/jasp-desktop/commit/05efd4671dc87da184d8583075e3684604e98e96)
- Resizing a plot may use encoded variable name (https://github.com/jasp-stats/jasp-desktop/commit/68c88d53c04db185607501180f9daf3076b7fe3a)
